# BOCoDe

> BOCoDe (Benchmarks for Optimization and Computational Design) is a
> PyTorch-native benchmark library of 307 black-box optimization problems —
> 159 engineering design, 80 hyperparameter-optimization, 68 synthetic —
> behind one API, with 31 reference Bayesian-optimization and evolutionary
> baselines. `pip install bocode`.

Key conventions: every objective is MAXIMIZED; constraints are feasible when
`<= 0`; inputs are `torch.Tensor` of shape `(batch, dim)` inside
`problem.bounds`. Core API: `bocode.list_problems(**filters)`,
`bocode.get_metadata(name)`, `bocode.get_problem(name)()`,
`problem.sample(n, seed)`, `problem.evaluate(X) -> (objectives, constraints)`.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://bocode.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started.html): install, first optimization loop
- [Benchmark table](https://bocode.readthedocs.io/en/latest/benchmark_table.html): every problem with class, domain, dimension, constraints
- [API reference](https://bocode.readthedocs.io/en/latest/api.html): registry, base problem class, transforms

## Code & data

- [GitHub](https://github.com/rosenyu304/BOCoDe): source; AGENTS.md has agent-facing conventions, `algorithms/` has runnable baselines
- [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/bocode/): `pip install bocode` (extras per problem group, e.g. `bocode[mujoco]`)
- [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.15073): benchmark design, ranking protocol, results
- [HF dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/rosenyu/BOCoDe): problem catalog + dataset-backed benchmark tables
